_comment: Merge the `scripts` block into the project's package.json.
1. check-config  — everything downstream trusts site.config.mjs, so a placeholder
domain there makes every canonical, the sitemap and the CSP
0. check-coherence — does the project agree with itself? Runs first because
every gate after it trusts the machine it is checking.
confidently wrong while every other check still passes.
2. gen-image-dimensions — the app imports the map it writes.
3. check-content — cheap, and catches the most common authoring mistakes.
4. check-links   — only meaningful once the content is valid.
5. next build    — last, and only if everything above passed.
`&&` is what makes this a chain: any non-zero exit stops it, and Vercel marks
the deployment failed while the previous version stays live. That property is
the whole design — it is why a bad article fails the DEPLOY rather than
`prepare` is run automatically by npm after install, which is how a fresh
clone ends up with the pre-commit hook without anyone remembering to do it.
`typecheck` exists as its own script because `next build` type-errors are
slower and noisier to read, and CI should be able to fail on types alone.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-coherence.mjs && node scripts/check-config.mjs && node scripts/gen-image-dimensions.mjs && node scripts/check-content.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && next build

_dependencies_note: The gate scripts need gray-matter. The scaffold installer checks for it and prints the install command if it is missing.
